title: Spanish Language – Level 01
overview: This introductory Spanish language program develops essential communication skills for learners with little or no previous knowledge of Spanish. Through guided speaking, listening, reading and writing activities, participants learn to use practical expressions, understand simple exchanges and communicate confidently in familiar everyday situations. The program introduces foundational grammar, high-frequency vocabulary and pronunciation while establishing a pathway for further study.
audience: Complete beginners seeking a structured introduction to Spanish.
Professionals who need basic Spanish for simple social or customer-facing interactions.
Travelers and individuals interested in Spanish-speaking cultures.
Learners preparing to progress to Spanish Language – Level 02.
methodology: Interactive, instructor-led explanations followed by guided language practice.
Paired dialogues, role-plays and realistic everyday communication tasks.
Listening exercises, pronunciation drills and short reading activities.
Structured writing practice, vocabulary recycling and formative feedback.
Short quizzes, speaking checkpoints and an integrated end-of-course assessment.
competencies: Recognize and produce basic Spanish sounds and commonly used expressions.
Exchange personal information and participate in short, predictable conversations.
Understand simple spoken instructions and brief everyday messages.
Read and write short sentences using elementary vocabulary and grammar.
Use culturally appropriate greetings and polite expressions.
objectives: Introduce oneself and others, ask basic questions and respond appropriately.
Use common present-tense verbs and simple sentence patterns accurately.
Describe people, places, routines, preferences and immediate needs.
Handle simple interactions involving time, shopping, food and directions.
Comprehend short texts and audio exchanges on familiar topics.
Produce short written messages and demonstrate readiness for Level 02.
